distribution.summary: Heilongjiang; Liaoning; Qinghai; Sichuan; Xizang; Gansu; Inner Mongolia; Xinjiang
distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) reported Heilongjiang (Dailing), Liaoning (Zhaowuda League), Qinghai (Qilian Mountains), Sichuan (Shuajingsi). Huang & Lu (2015) reported Heilongjiang, Liaoning, Qinghai, Sichuan, Xizang. These are literature-based occurrence reports; Mainland China remains Candidate pending occurrence review. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Gansu, Inner Mongolia, Xinjiang as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: Host names are retained as published, with a citation for each reported association. Where both 1984 and 2015 list the same host, the records should not be assumed to represent independent confirmations. Host associations have not undergone independent review.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Dendroctonus micans (Kugelann, 1794).
